import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tools')
from controller import run
import verify
def case(**kw):
    base = {'model':'cnn','class_values':[1,1,1,1,1,1,1],'stats':[1,1,75],'bucket':[2,2],
            'slots':[[0,2,0],[1,2,1],[2,2,1]],'flows':[[1,4,-1,0]],'groups':[],
            'windows':[[0,0,2,1,1,0,1,[[0,0]]*9]]}
    base.update(kw); return base
tests = [
  ('stats-huge', case(stats=[10**9,10**9,10**9])),
  ('stats-huge2', case(stats=[10**9,1,75])),
  ('stats-v-huge', case(stats=[1,1,10**9])),
  ('draw-65535', case(windows=[[0,0,2,1,1,65535,1,[[0,0]]*9]])),
  ('draw-max-pass', case(windows=[[0,0,2,1,320,65534,1,[[0,0]]*9]])),
  ('T-max-C-max', case(windows=[[0,0,2,65535,320,0,1,[[0,0]]*9]])),
  ('no-window', case(windows=[])),
  ('zero-cap-slots', case(slots=[[0,0,0],[1,0,0]])),
  ('group-zero-ceiling', case(groups=[[ -1,0]], flows=[[1,4,0,0]])),
  ('deep-groups', case(groups=[[-1,4],[0,3],[1,2],[2,1]], flows=[[1,4,3,0]])),
  ('expires-before-first-slot', case(windows=[[0,0,0,1,1,0,1,[[0,0]]*9]], slots=[[5,2,0]])),

  ('bucket-zero-init', case(bucket=[4,0])),
  ('many-flows-one-window', case(flows=[[1,1,-1,0],[1,1,-1,1],[1,1,-1,2]])),
  ('rnn', case(model='rnn')),
]
bad=0
for name, c in tests:
    out=run(json.dumps({'version':3,'cases':[c]}).encode())
    if 'error' in out: print(name,'INVALID!', out); bad+=1; continue
    res=out['results'][0]
    errs=verify.check(c,res); errs=verify.check_reports(c,res,errs)
    print('%-28s ratio=%s util=%s age=%s cut=%s %s' % (name, res['ratio'], res['utility'], res['age'], (res['cut'] is not None), 'OK' if not errs else errs[:3]))
    if errs: bad+=1
